instruction: Write an XDP program that must index sender traffic in LRU map 'client_flow_04' while incrementing interface total in 'sys_stats_04'. Return XDP_PASS for all traffic.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'client_flow_04' with key __u32 and value __u64
Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_ARRAY map 'sys_stats_04' with 4 entries and value __u64
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Lookup ip->saddr in client_flow_04 and increment counter
Lookup index 0 in sys_stats_04 and increment global counter
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration

tests.name: pass_ip
tests.description: IP tracked in both maps and passed
